text:
Lina Gomez: Quick debrief from Cedar Financial security call — they asked for artifacts to prove recent RBAC changes, KMS rotation history, and a concise incident triage timeline. Can the security/infra team confirm what we can safely share and the production steps?

Jen Park: Thanks Lina. High level: RBAC change history + owner list, KMS rotation events + attestations, and a sanitized timeline with log excerpts should cover most asks. Need the exact customer questions to map artifacts.

Lina Gomez: Pasted from their email: 
- Provide list of service accounts and role bindings changed in last 12 months (who approved + PRs).
- KMS: rotation records, key material custody statement, and whether keys ever left HSMs.
- Incident: timeline for last minor incident (2026-02-14), logs showing detection -> mitigation, and evidence of post-incident remediations.

Jen Park: OK. Proposed deliverables: 
- RBAC: CSV of role bindings + change log (from git/Terraform plan) + approver usernames.
- KMS: CloudTrail export for KMS events, DescribeKey output, and our BYOK/HSM attestation PDF.
- Incident: redacted SIEM excerpts (timestamps, event types, anonymized principals) + short timeline doc.

Mike Alvarez: I can pull the CloudTrail events and TF history. Example CLI to pull rotation events:
```
aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventName,AttributeValue=EnableKeyRotation --start-time 2025-01-01 --end-time 2026-03-01 
```
For key metadata: 
```
aws kms describe-key --key-id arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-1234
```
I will generate a sanitized CSV and upload to the secure bucket.

Sofia Patel: Important: do NOT share raw logs with PII. Our export pipeline should redact ipAddress, userIdentity.sessionContext.* and any requestParameters that include payloads. I'll paste the SIEM filter we'll use:
```
index=redwood-prod sourcetype=cloudtrail | where eventTime>="2026-02-14T00:00:00Z" AND eventTime<="2026-02-15T00:00:00Z" | fields eventTime, eventName, userIdentity.arn, sourceIPAddress, awsRegion, errorCode
| eval sourceIPAddress=if(match(sourceIPAddress,\"^10\\.\"),\"internal\",\"REDACTED\")
```
We should also include a short explanation of redaction in the bundle.

Jen Park: Good call. For RBAC approvals I can collate PR links and reviewers (we keep approvals in GitHub + SSO audit). Mike, who owns the terraform state for tenant infra? I need to pull the plan diffs.

Mike Alvarez: I own tenant infra state. I'll run `git log -p -- terraform/roles` and export the diffs for the timeframe. Will mark PRs and approvers.

sec-bot: Artifact generation job queued: JOB-8791 (sanitized-export). ETA ~2 hours to start, will post link when ready.

Lina Gomez: The customer also requested a signed statement on key custody and rotation cadence (quarterly). Legal needs to sign off on attestation. Who should I loop from Legal?

Sofia Patel: Loop Legal and Compliance (I can introduce). Also confirm whether Cedar accepts pseudonymized IDs instead of full ARNs — that reduces exposure and speeds delivery. If they require raw ARNs, we need a DPA review.

Jen Park: I'll draft the artifact checklist and an explanatory note about scope+redactions. Plan: collect RBAC CSV, KMS CloudTrail slice, DescribeKey outputs, HSM attestation PDF, and sanitized SIEM excerpts. Target delivery: EOD tomorrow.

Mike Alvarez: Confirmed. I'll run exports and upload to secure bucket linked to JOB-8791. ETA 18:00 PT tomorrow.

Lina Gomez: Awesome, thanks :pray: I'll tell Cedar Financial we have a plan and will share artifacts after Legal review. Scheduling a 30 min follow-up for next Tue.

Jen Park: One more thing — include a short 'scope & limitations' note stating what we redact and why (PII, internal hostnames). That usually satisfies QSA reviewers. :thumbsup:

Mike Alvarez: Noted. I'll include the sanitized diff and a checksum for each artifact.

Sofia Patel: I'll prepare the redaction checklist and sign-off template for Legal.

Lina Gomez: Perfect — I'll close the loop with Cedar and post the follow-up invite. Thanks team!
